skills.name: git-commit-helper
skills.description: Use when the user asks to write or review a Conventional Commit message. Turns a staged diff into one scoped, single-purpose commit line.

skills.name: device-log-analyzer
skills.description: Use when the user pastes device, BLE, firmware or app logs and wants a phased root-cause timeline. Produces a full command inventory, an HTML report and concrete next checks.

rule_catalog.title: Frontmatter 存在
rule_catalog.why: Agent 靠 frontmatter 决定是否加载 skill

rule_catalog.title: name 字段
rule_catalog.why: 没有稳定标识，无法去重与引用

rule_catalog.title: description 字段
rule_catalog.why: description 是唯一的触发依据

rule_catalog.title: 触发条件清晰
rule_catalog.why: 过短或不带触发词的描述会让 skill 永远不被唤起

rule_catalog.title: description 不过长
rule_catalog.why: 描述越长，常驻上下文成本越高

rule_catalog.title: 正文可渐进披露
rule_catalog.why: 超长正文应拆到 references/ 按需加载

rule_catalog.title: 引用的文件存在
rule_catalog.why: 指向不存在脚本的 skill 会直接执行失败

rule_catalog.title: 无敏感凭据
rule_catalog.why: skill 会被整体注入上下文，泄露风险最高；命中即封顶 D

rule_catalog.title: 不与其它 skill 重复
rule_catalog.why: 近重复 skill 会互相抢触发、浪费预算

rule_catalog.title: 有可运行示例
rule_catalog.why: 无需真实账号即可验证，决定冷启动转化
